elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Your phone buzzes on every single letter you type?

[confident] Here's the fix. Switch off the keyboard buzz.

[friendly] Open Gboard settings, then Preferences. Turn off Haptic feedback on keypress. Turn off the keypress sound too.

[delighted] Now you can text in bed without buzzing like a wasp.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
